ios.desc:
ThunDroid AI is your personal intelligence. It is an AI companion for feelings and ordinary days: talk when you need someone, write when you need to see a pattern, and breathe when your body is ahead of you.

TALK Speak in Live Voice, or type. ThunDroid draws on CBT, DBT, and ACT, three approaches used in therapy, and stays with what you have already said. It is a companion for the moments between sessions. It does not replace a clinician.

JOURNAL Fifteen guided templates, including a CBT thought record, a DBT diary card, gratitude, sleep, and goals, plus mood, streaks, and history. Journal entries are encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM. 

BREATHE Thirteen guided techniques, including cyclic sighing, the exercise a Stanford study found reduced anxiety faster than mindfulness meditation, plus box breathing, 4-7-8, resonance, alternate nostril, and the Wim Hof method. Visual guides and haptic cues. Breathing works offline.

PRIVACY Chat is sent over a secure connection to ThunDroid’s servers so the companion can respond. Your journal is different: it stays on your device, protected with AES-256-GCM. ThunDroid does not sell your journal or your conversations.

Start with 3 days free. Full access. Cancel anytime.

Privacy Policy: https://aetherrax.com/privacy-policy-aetherrax-technologies/ Terms of Use: https://aetherrax.com/terms-of-service-aetherrax-technologies/

quotes.text:
Hey Hacker News readers,

We're the team from Aetherrax Technologies, and we'd like to share something we've been building: ThunDroid AI.

The goal was to create a genuinely helpful tool for emotional wellness without making the usual privacy compromises. We noticed that many apps in this space have vague data policies, and we wanted to build an alternative where the user is in complete control.

ThunDroid AI is an emotional support companion that runs on your iPhone. It's a private space to talk through your thoughts with an AI, use guided journaling prompts, or go through breathing exercises.

Here’s how we’re approaching this, keeping a tech-savvy audience in mind:

Privacy-First by Design: This is our core principle. All conversations are end-to-end encrypted, and all of your data is stored exclusively on your device. We have no access to it. We don't use your conversations for training data. What you say in the app, stays in the app.

No Cloud, No Servers for Your Data: Your journal entries and chat logs are not uploaded to our servers. It's a local-first experience.

Core Features: The app offers unlimited AI conversations, smart journaling with prompts for different wellness areas, and a set of evidence-based breathing techniques.

We just launched on the App Store and are looking for honest feedback, especially from this community. We're open to all thoughts on the app's utility, our approach to privacy, and any features you think might be missing.
